area: Eastern Offshore deepwater — KG basin extension
rationale: The one growing source: +337% (0.56→2.44 MMT) as ONGC KG-DWN-98/2 ramped. Step-out around producing deepwater cluster is de-risked.
India's biggest frontier upside — direct along-strike analog to Indonesia's 2023-24 giant gas finds (Geng North / Layaran, ~5+ TCF each) just across the maritime boundary. Barely drilled.
Gas-prone deepwater between the proven KG and Bengal fans; under-drilled. Rides the same East-Coast petroleum system as KG.
Adjacent to KG success on the same margin; shallow Cauvery already produces. Deepwater flank largely untested.
Defence 'No-Go' zones opened 2016-22 unlocked ~99% of restricted offshore/onshore — vast new-to-industry acreage on the west & east margins now biddable via OALP.
Under-explored western-margin basin near proven Mumbai/Gujarat systems; recent ONGC interest.
Mumbai High is a mature decliner (−16%); the deeper Arabian-Sea flank of the same prolific basin is comparatively untested.
87 already-discovered fields awarded but many undeveloped — fastest, cheapest barrels; no exploration risk, only development.

area: EOR/IOR in mature fields (Mumbai High, Barmer)
rationale: Barmer collapsed 6.65→3.43 MMT (−48%) and Mumbai High is declining; enhanced recovery adds barrels cheaper than any new hole.
